title: API down (transcriber-api)
description: The FastAPI service on {{ $labels.instance }} has not been in the active state for 2 minutes. Check `systemctl status transcriber-api` and `journalctl -u transcriber-api -n 50` inside the container. Frontend requests will fail with 502 through Caddy.

title: Worker not running (rq-worker)
description: An RQ worker unit has not been active for 5 minutes, so queued videos will not be transcribed. Check `systemctl status {{ $labels.name }}` on {{ $labels.instance }}. If it is crash-looping with 'There exists an active worker named ...', delete rq:worker:scriber-worker-<ct> and its rq:workers entry in redis on 203 first.

title: Worker restart loop (rq-worker)
description: The active state of {{ $labels.name }} changed more than twice in 20 minutes. This is the shape of the stale RQ registration crash-loop: the unit starts, RQ refuses the name, systemd restarts it. Check redis for rq:worker:scriber-worker-<ct>.

title: Queue backlog (scriber-queue)
description: More than 5 uploads have been queued for 10 minutes. Either the GPU workers are down, slower than arrival, or one long file is blocking. Check `redis-cli llen rq:queue:transcribe-gpu` on 203 and worker state on 204/205.

title: Failed transcriptions (scriber-jobs)
summary: {{ $value }} new failed transcription(s) in the last 30 minutes
description: One or more videos moved into the failed state. Inspect `select id, filename, created_at from public.videos where status='failed' order by created_at desc` and the worker journal for the traceback.

title: Disk usage high (scriber-nodes)
summary: Root filesystem on {{ $labels.instance }} is {{ printf "%.1f" $value }}% full
description: The container rootfs (backed by neoDATA) has been above 80% for 10 minutes. Uploads, media and the prod Supabase volumes share this pool. Prune old media under /mnt/media/videos/<user_uuid> or grow the dataset before ZFS hits 85%.

title: GPU wedged (scriber-gpu)
summary: GPU on {{ $labels.instance }} holds {{ printf "%.0f" $value }}% of its memory with no compute
description: A Tesla P4 has held over 90% of its VRAM with under 1% utilisation for 20 minutes: a worker process is stuck or leaked and new jobs will fail to allocate. Restart rq-worker@<ct> on {{ $labels.instance }}; if memory does not drop, kill the python process holding the context.

title: GPU temperature high (scriber-gpu)
description: Sustained temperature above 85C. Check airflow and fan speed in the R630; a Pascal P4 throttles above ~90C and transcription times climb.

title: Metrics exporter down (scriber-exporters)
description: The {{ $labels.job }} exporter at {{ $labels.instance }} has been unreachable for 10 minutes, so queue/failure/GPU rules are blind. Check `systemctl status app-exporter` (202) or `gpu-exporter` (204/205).
